# Swipe Transforms Khushboo Baheti's Wedding Wear Business | A Testimonial


## About Khushboo Baheti's Business


> Crossing the path of making her imprint in the Indian bridal industry, Khushboo Baheti began design work for a luxury wedding label, constructing bridal lehengas and occasion wear. Set against the pandemic background in 2020, the business was now in need of an advanced management of a complicated inventory and billing that was in contrast with its competitive nature.


## The Need for a Streamlined System


Struggled during the pandemic with sourcing skilled artisans and building client trust. “The initial challenges that I faced during my career was finding the right artisans for my collection,” she said. As her business grew, managing inventory, sending automated bills to clients, and billing became difficult.


## Enter Swipe: Simplifying Operations


After trying out different software, always meeting with some issue or the other, Khushboo finally discovered Swipe. “I have used many softwares, but I was never happy. There was some or the other glitch in the software,” she shared. Swipe’s intuitive features changed that.


Here is how her business got changed by Swipe:


1. **Fast Setup:** The onboarding was very simple with Swipe, and her team was ready within a day. "The whole setup was very user-friendly. It hardly took a day to configure everything," she said.
2. **Easy Inventory Management:** Swipe took the pain of managing her products. "I have dealt with a lot of customization; it is very difficult to handle inventory." Swipe helps me, by using the feature of having a separate picture for each inventory,” Khushboo explained. “This helps me to keep each and every product differently.”
3. **Smart Billing with Payment Tracking:** Swipe records payment details on invoices, saving time. “The best feature is that it mentions the mode of payment with the date on the bill,” she said. “This was not available in any of the other softwares.”
4. **Customization Notes:** Swipe’s note-keeping feature ensures no detail is missed. “Swipe helps me to maintain notes in every piece with the different customization; this helps me to recollect what I have customized,” she noted.


## A Game-Changer for Wedding Wear


Swipe streamlined the operational processes, eliminating the need for a multitude of platforms. Khushboo sounds confident about Swipe: "Now I’m not gonna switch to any other software… this is the final thing I’m going to stick to," she said.


## Final Words from Khushboo


"Swipe has paved the way for streamlining our operations. From setup to everyday usage, smooth is the word, methodically engineered to help you grow."


For businesses of wedding wear dealing with complex inventory and billing, Swipe is a blessing!
